# MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS

# NOTIFICATION

New Delhi, the 24th September, 2026

**S.O. 5271(E).**— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways, **1887(E) Dated:13/04/2026,** published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Subsection (ii) issued under sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter 
referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in the Schedule 
annexed to the said notification for building (widening/four-laning, etc.), maintenance, management and operation of 
NH139W in the stretch of land from Km. 17.200 to Km. 42.045 in the district of WEST CHAMPARAN in the state of 
BIHAR

[F. No. NHAI/PIU/MOTIHARI/BHARATMALA/139W/Areraj-Bettiah/3D]

SHAIKH AMINKHAN, Director
